description: Schema for each row in the libraries.csv file used by cellranger multi (v9). Each record corresponds to a library with metadata required for analysis. See the 10X documentation for details.

fastq_id.description: A unique identifier for the library.

fastqs.description: Path to a directory containing fastq files

feature_types.description: The type of library. Valid options (per 10X documentation) include 'Gene Expression', 'Antibody Capture', 'VDJ-T', 'VDJ-B'
